title: MYC-MAX MD Analysis Pipeline: scripts for the identification of candidate pockets at the MYC-MAX interface
description:
All Python scripts used for analyzing the molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of the c-MYC:MAX complex and its individual components, together with the workflow employed in the study Identification of Candidate Pockets at the MYC-MAX Interface for Protein-Protein Interaction Disruption.

The pipeline covers: conformational analysis of isolated c-MYC (RMSD, RMSF, Rg); comparison of isolated vs. MAX-bound c-MYC; interface contacts, MM-GBSA per-residue energy decomposition and persistent salt bridges of the complex; trajectory-based pocket detection with MDpocket and physicochemical characterization of the sub-pockets; and a triple-method consensus of interface hotspots. Generated results (figures, tables and ChimeraX scripts) are included in the Results/ directory. Raw MD trajectories are not included due to their size (>50 GB).
